goal: Abort early on malformed network and RPC data during deserialization
Protects nodes from memory and CPU exhaustion caused by crafted blocks and transactions
reviewability: No blockers or pending changes invalidate review
agreement: Overall support with all review questions addressed
Support after clarifying the complexity and CPU trade-offs (maflcko)
Addressed concern that keeping invalid blocks in flight could stall downloads (Yudis-bit)
Approval from an account with no project history and no stated reason was not counted (Husteem)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it limits node vulnerability to memory exhaustion attacks from untrusted peers
Significantly lowers the worst-case CPU and RAM allocated to invalid P2P data before rejection

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it equips the serialization framework with reusable state tracking for streaming inputs
Allows future deserialization code to enforce budgets without sacrificing streaming performance
